body.input: Which medical device companies entered the Finnish market in 2026?

response.content:
I was unable to find a specific, comprehensive list of medical device companies that entered the Finnish market in 2026. However, based on available information, here are some notable developments related to medical devices and Finland in 2026:

- **G Square / Serres** – In January 2026, European healthcare private equity firm G Square signed an agreement to acquire a majority stake in **Serres**, a Finnish medical device company (based in Kauhajoki) specializing in sustainable surgical fluid management solutions, with the aim of accelerating its global expansion.

- **Helsinki Partners' 90 Hour Helsinki Program** – In June 2026, Helsinki Partners invited international companies to explore R&D partnerships in life sciences and AI/deep tech, positioning Helsinki as a cost-efficient hub for biotech and pharma R&D in Europe.

- **Norway Health Tech Resource Group for Finland** – A new initiative was launched to help Norwegian health technology companies explore the Finnish market, with meetings covering market overview and entry points, including the Lapland Testbed for testing solutions in real service environments.

- **VTT Pilot Line in Oulu** – VTT Technical Research Centre of Finland opened a new pilot line environment for medical devices in Oulu, designed to help startups and companies accelerate the path from R&D to market for non-invasive devices (e.g., early cancer detection, remote heart disease monitoring).

- **Digital Health Finland advisory services** – As of November 2026, Digital Health Finland was actively offering advisory and consulting services to help international companies enter the Finnish health technology market.

Finland's medical device market is regulated by the Finnish Medicines Agency (Fimea), which oversees registrations through the national CERE register and the EU-wide EUDAMED database. Specific company-by-company market entry records for 2026 are not publicly available in an aggregated format. For a detailed list of new entrants, Fimea's CERE register or the EUDAMED database would be the most authoritative sources to consult.

context.content: # G Square acquires majority stake in Finnish MedTech company Serres to accelerate global growth and sustainability leadership. ESPOO, Finland, Jan. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- **G Square, a leading European healthcare private equity investor focusing on mid-market companies with high growth potential, has signed an agreement to acquire a majority stake in Serres, a global forerunner in sustainable surgical fluid management solutions, to accelerate its global expansion and sustainability leadership.**. "Serres is an outstanding company; a true European champion in its field with world-class sustainable products and a strong culture of innovation. "We are excited to partner with the Jyllilä family to support Serres and its management team in accelerating growth, widening international reach and strengthening Serres' leading market position in sustainable solutions for surgery and intensive care," adds **Yasemin Arik, Partner of G Square**. Founded over five decades ago, Serres has grown as a family-owned company based in Kauhajoki, Finland, into one of the global leaders in surgical fluid management.

context.content: # Helsinki Invites International Companies to Explore R&D Partnerships in Life Sciences and AI & Deep Tech. HELSINKI, June 3, 2026 /PRNewswire/ --**Helsinki Partners, together with the****City of Helsinki and the University of Helsinki****, is inviting international companies to explore research and development partnerships at two of the city's leading innovation environments. The 90 Hour Helsinki Program gives access to two university-driven innovation clusters: Viikki is a leading ecosystem for life sciences, biotech, and sustainability, and Kumpula for AI and deep tech research. | **Facts at a glance**  • Helsinki is the most cost-efficient city in Europe for biotech and pharma R&D  • The Helsinki region ranks 1st in the EU for innovative SMEs collaborating with others  • The region also leads in R&D expenditure in the business sector and international scientific co-publications  • The University of Helsinki ranks in the top 1% of universities globally  • ASM's partnership with the University of Helsinki spans more than 20 years |.

## Description

Finland is a natural next market for many Norwegian health technology companies. NHT’s new resource group for Finland brings together companies that want to learn more about the Finnish market, build networks and find the right entry points. At this first meeting, we will give an overview of the market and show how Arctic test and development environments can help develop and validate solutions for sparsely populated regions. The group will provide insight into how the market works, access to relevant stakeholders and an opportunity to share experiences with other companies.

At the first meeting, Vilma Portti, Project Manager, and Marko Vatanen, Project Manager and Senior Lecturer, from Lapland Testbed will present the Finnish market as a whole and the Lapland region. [...] Lapland and Lapland Testbed
